# Humic.blog — The Authoritative Educational Encyclopedia on Humic Substances

> Humic.blog is an independent, vendor-neutral, peer-reviewed educational encyclopedia covering the soil chemistry, geological origins, alkaline extraction, ISO 19822 / IHSS analytical verification, precision agronomic application, biostimulant synergies, global organic regulations, and ecological sustainability of humic and fulvic substances.

## Editorial & Scientific Standards
- Domain: https://humic.blog
- Analytical Standards: ISO 19822:2018 (Lamar / HPTA Method), IHSS Reference Protocols, AAPFCO, EU FPR 2019/1009, India FCO Schedule VI.
- Agronomic Scope: Strictly vendor-neutral and legally compliant (soil conditioning, cation exchange capacity, nutrient use efficiency, abiotic stress tolerance). No pesticidal, fungicidal, or medicinal claims.
- Sitemap: https://humic.blog/sitemap-index.xml

## Core Encyclopedia Pages
- [Homepage — Encyclopedia Authority Hub](https://humic.blog): Overview of all 7 scientific knowledge pillars, interactive field calculators, and standardized humic science glossary.

## Cornerstone Scientific Guides (Batch 1 & 2)
- [The 70-Million-Year Formation of Humic Substances & 10 Remarkable Soil Science Facts](https://humic.blog/origins/formation-and-shocking-facts): Geological formation of leonardite, Humic vs. Fulvic vs. Humin solubility table, 10 lesser-known properties (supramolecular assembly, electron shuttling, CEC, H+-ATPase signaling), and what humic acid is not.
- [Humic Acid Raw Materials & Alkaline Extraction: Leonardite vs. Lignite, Peat, and KOH vs. NaOH](https://humic.blog/raw-materials/raw-materials-and-extraction): Feedstock comparison (leonardite, lignite, peat, compost), alkaline solubilization steps, potassium humate benefits, and sodium humate clay-dispersion and sodicity risks.
- [Humic Acid Market Malpractices & Analytical Testing: ISO 19822 vs. IHSS vs. CDFA vs. Colorimetric](https://humic.blog/quality-and-testing/market-malpractices-and-testing): Seven common market malpractices (sodium lignosulfonate sulfur marker >3% vs <0.75%, coal dust, colorimetric inflation, ash bias) and side-by-side ISO 19822 (Lamar) vs. IHSS vs. CDFA vs. Colorimetric comparison.
- [Complete Humic Acid Application & Tank-Mix Guide: Soil, Drip Fertigation, Foliar & Seed Protocols](https://humic.blog/agronomy/complete-application-and-tank-mix-guide): Field protocols for soil broadcast, drip fertigation (120-mesh filtration, 25-50-25 flush), foliar sprays, seed coating, hard-water precautions (>250 ppm CaCO3), and 5-step jar testing.
- [Universal Humic Acid Crop Calendar & 5 Critical Field Precautions](https://humic.blog/agronomy/crop-calendar-and-precautions): Stage-by-stage phenological schedule from basal preparation to pre-flowering, plus 5 essential precautions (hormetic overdosing, hard borewell water, midday heat, hygroscopic storage, flushing drip lines).
- [Biostimulant Synergies: Combining Humic Acid, Seaweed Extract (Ascophyllum nodosum) & L-Amino Acids](https://humic.blog/synergies/humic-seaweed-amino-synergies): Complementary rhizosphere, stress-signaling, and metabolic pathways of humic substances, Ascophyllum nodosum kelp, and enzymatic L-amino acids, plus pH >= 6.0 tank-mix rules.
- [Global Humic Acid Laws & Organic Farming Standards: USDA NOP/OMRI, EU FPR 2019/1009, AAPFCO & India FCO](https://humic.blog/regulations/global-organic-laws-and-standards): Worldwide regulatory and organic certification matrix covering USDA NOP (OMRI), EU FPR 2019/1009, EU Organic 2018/848, US AAPFCO/CDFA, and India FCO Schedule VI / NPOP.
- [Humic Substances, Sustainability & Global Food Security: Nutrient Efficiency, Waterways & Soil Biodiversity](https://humic.blog/soil-and-sustainability/sustainability-biodiversity-food-security): Nitrogen and phosphorus use efficiency (NUE/PUE), waterway eutrophication reduction, mycorrhizal fungi and earthworm biodiversity, and degraded-land restoration.

## Interactive Agronomic Tools & Standardized Reference Hub
- [Potassium Humate & Fulvic Acid Dosage Calculator](https://humic.blog/tools/dosage-calculator): Interactive calculator for Drip Fertigation, Soil Broadcast, Foliar Spray, and Seed Treatment in Acres or Hectares with soil organic matter adjustment.
- [Potassium Humate Tank-Mix Compatibility Checker](https://humic.blog/tools/tank-mix-checker): Instant Green/Amber/Red compatibility screening for mixing Potassium Humate or Fulvic Acid with Calcium Nitrate, Low-pH Acids (Phosphoric/Nitric), Urea/NPK, Seaweed Extract, L-Amino Acids, and Magnesium Sulfate, with precipitation chemistry explanations.
- [A–Z Humic Science Glossary](https://humic.blog/glossary): 18 standardized IHSS and ISO 19822 definitions (CEC, Chelation, DAX-8 Resin, Fulvic Acid, Humic Acid, Humin, Humification, ISO 19822, Leonardite, Potassium Humate, Sodium Lignosulfonate, Supramolecular Assembly, and more) encoded in DefinedTermSet JSON-LD.
